reason: Plan implements approved specification v004 exactly: one global stylesheet with CSS custom-property tokens, class-name-only markup changes to App.tsx/TaskList.tsx, and a new feature-detected useRevealOnScroll hook (TaskCard split) for the AC8 scroll reveal, with prefers-reduced-motion handled purely in CSS. Badge/text colour pairs were contrast-checked against WCAG's formula (8.1-11.9:1) ahead of implementation. Each AC maps to a named unit, component or Playwright test, all in new files so the existing App.test.tsx and e2e/app.spec.ts stay untouched. Coordination section and an info/major finding flag the live overlap with SDLC-7 on src/App.tsx and recommend rebasing onto main after SDLC-7 merges. An ADR records the hook/graceful-degradation/CSS-reduced-motion design decision.
